data.standardized_narrative: For the 2018 calendar year, the syndicate experienced a gross prior accident year adverse development of $5.1 million. This strengthening was influenced by losses from closed years (2009-2015) and significant impacts on the 2016 and 2017 underwriting years from events such as Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, and Maria, as well as Mexican earthquakes and California wildfires.

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure of $5.113 million is explicitly stated as 'adverse development of claims incurred' in the Claims note. While the narrative on page 6 discusses specific underwriting year results and event impacts (e.g., Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, Maria) on prior years, these are often presented as net figures or overall year-of-account results, not direct contributions to the $5.113 million calendar year prior year development. The gross claims development triangle on page 48 shows a large release when calculated by comparing current estimates to previous diagonals for older underwriting years, which contradicts the explicit statement of adverse development in the Claims note. The explicit statement is prioritized as per instructions.
